name: Defensive tactics
prompt: Mat work: a classmate twice your weight, two minutes, and you have to get to your feet and away.

choices.text: Work the move slowly and take the instructor's corrections

outcome.told: You don't win the round, but the instructor marks your technique as passing.
You break the hold and get to the wall. The class claps once, as it does.

failure.told: Your shoulder goes the wrong way. You sit the rest of the session out with ice on it.
